lessons.claim: When migrating to RUN.builder, if a value the original main() passed straight into simulate() (seed, L_star, Dr_star, tau_tumble_star and so on) is missing from spec.params/numerics, build(spec) has no way of obtaining it -- because build() reads only the spec and does not re-read the case YAML. Before migrating, the argument list of the simulate() call in main() has to be compared against the key list of spec.params/numerics to find what is missing. All three cases were missing at least one each (seed or a Dr_star-like value). Adding these values changes the run_id (they are fields included in the physics hash) but is safe -- the existing run_id directories remain as they are.
